title: A test: silicon ore gathered at Glasslight Shoal (Clearwater, lawless) into storage at Node Beta for the faction's circuit boards
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-17 08:45 UTC (orders.log ENT-032, block APOLLO (4): the 125 circuit boards of the two offices; rules F3, F13). The route maker's candidate mine-glasslight-shoal sells the silicon at Node Beta at 32 cr; this route stores it instead: 2 silicon ore and 12 carbon ore make 3 circuit boards by hand (carbon_arc_circuit_etching), and Central Nexus asks silicon at 420 cr (book of 07:53 UTC). The field read 322 silicon ore of 20,000 at richness 40 (scouting/clearwater.json, 2026-11-17 08:15 UTC): the first silicon field our readings show with ore in it (admirals.log ENT-003 found none). The way: 9 jumps from Node Beta, 8 of them lawless (GSC-0050, Brachium, Nightveil, Marfik, Regor, Groombridge 34, Innes 40), out with an empty hold (rule F13). One ship until its first RESULT line is read; min_left keeps one load in the field. Mining gathers silicon where a field has it (its block): Mining may claim the field, and this route then leaves the hauler plan.
